item.tib: mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol mchog de'i rgyud las dka' thub sbyong ba'i thabs bcud len thar pa'i brgyag phye
item.coloph: dgongs pa rang grol gyi rgyud las/ bcud len thar pa'i brgyags phye 'di ni/ rgyal mo rgya yi rong chen gyi byang gnas ka ke'u nyi ma rang shar du/ thos chung kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying po bdag gis dge byed rnams kyi snying nor du bkod pa/ sa rta zla ba bdun pa'i dkar phyogs la bgyis so//
